_doc: The one threshold source for audio-bucket retention, both ways. Floor: every lifecycle Delete that can reach a protected prefix has age >= max(hold days) + margin_days; a hold with days=null (or a pending ruling) forbids any age Delete there. Ceiling: soft delete, versioning and cache max ages a bucket may not exceed. Read by backend/scripts/check_sync_staging_lifecycle.py (release prerequisite; floors enforce, ceilings report) and by the workspace's infra/rollout/bin/retention_check.py and drift.sh (git show origin/main:<this file>). 11-01: a whole-bucket 7-day Delete on the batch staging bucket removed 161 failed_held sync uploads held 8+ days, the only server copy.

batch_finalization_alarm.control: A 2 h alarm by age since enqueue that also covers units that never finalize (failed_held, quarantined, stuck before transcript), installed and verified (lane alarm2h). Until then this hold is unbounded.
batch_finalization_alarm.note: David: no 21-day deadline; most audio within 30 min of finalization, alarm at 2 h (lane alarm2h owns the alarm). failed_held/quarantined units still have no TTL in code (utils/batch_pipeline/retention.py: accepted audio must not silently expire) and never finalize, so only an age-since-enqueue alarm reaches them. Once that control is verified, the floor counts this hold until a human is alarmed (days = finalization_alarm_seconds) plus margin_days for the response, so a 30-day staging Delete leaves ~30 days after the alarm.

staging_custody.note: Accepted sync staging is held until durable custody (docs/runbooks/audio-cleanup-custody.md); no TTL, so no age Delete may reach it.

source_audio.note: Capture audio of record is retained indefinitely except authorized privacy deletion (David 2026-10-15, storage-lifecycle/FORWARD.md).

lake_space_content.note: Space lake content is removed only by explicit conversation/account deletion; no time-based expiry.

speech_profile.note: A user's speech profile lives until the user or account deletion removes it.

ceiling_sources.erasure_immediate: docs/runbooks/audio-cleanup-custody.md: privacy erasure must remain possible immediately (no retention lock, holds, or soft-deleted copies)
ceiling_sources.voice_evidence: utils/batch_pipeline/artifacts.py verify_voice_retention: soft delete must be 0
ceiling_sources.lake_forward: storage-lifecycle/lake-forward.json: versioning disabled and soft delete 0 at creation; data-access audit logs required.
ceiling_sources.canonical_forward: storage-lifecycle/FORWARD.md: versioning disabled and soft delete 0 at creation
ceiling_sources.declared_caches: storage-lifecycle/prod.json: merged/ Delete 3 d, playback/ Delete 30 d
ceiling_sources.user_controlled_voice: David 2026-11-12: raw voice for accounts that stay is retained until the user deletes it; automatic expiry of live source audio is forbidden. Explicit user/account privacy deletion remains allowed.

omi-private-cloud-sync.note: 2026-11-02: David dropped the existing-stock Coldline-to-Archive proposal (large one-time operation cost); prod.json and validate_storage_lifecycle.py permit only the Coldline transition. The rollout handoff reports only playback Delete 30 d and batch Coldline live. prod.json still declares merged/ Delete 3 d and noncurrent .opus.enc Delete; a prod apply would install both, pending explicit clearance. The new-empty-bucket canonical-forward policy is separate.
